name: SVC_COVERAGE_MILESTONES
description: Table to track SR milestone data for a given contract coverage

columns.name: MILESTONE_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table

columns.name: COVERAGE_ID
columns.description: A foreign key that references milestone config COVERAGE_ID in SVC_COVERAGES

columns.name: CALENDAR_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to calender defined in coverage time,  references COVERAGE_TIME_ID in OKC_COVERAGE_TIMES_B

columns.name: SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: A foreign key that references to schedules defined in OKC_CAL_SCHEDULES_B table.

columns.name: MILESTONE_CODE
columns.description: Code defined in contract objects for each milestone

columns.name: DUE_TIME
columns.description: Indicates the milestone due time configured in the standard coverage.

columns.name: DUE_TIME_UNIT
columns.description: Indicates the time unit for milestone due time.

columns.name: WARN_TIME
columns.description: Indicates the milestone warn time configured in the standard coverage.

columns.name: WARN_TIME_UNIT
columns.description: Indicates the time unit for milestone warning time.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
